read: 2026-10-09, by eye from the cached schematic image
comment: Redrawn schematic of the Electro-Harmonix Fuzz-Wah/Volume (model 3006): 1458 diode-clipping fuzz into a two-transistor inductor wah that S3 can turn into a volume pedal. Only diodes, transistors and switches carry designators; the rest are listed by value and quantity.
uncertain: S2: three-position selector drawn with a single blade, read as SP3T
S3: read as a three-pole changeover from the dashed ganging line
rows: fuzz input resistor; wah bias divider
1458 feedback; wah bias; Q2 base feed
electrolytic; 1458 bias and wah bias filter
wah/volume treadle pot, sweep reversed by S5
